description:
## Goal

The agent-inbox-side consumer of `cli introspect` output. Runs at scenario-startup to discover CLI commands from every running scenario, produces conversational descriptors consumable by the unified retrieval index, and handles invocation via shell-exec.

## Expected Work

- Discovery: on scenario-startup (or on a refresh trigger), call `<cli> introspect` for every registered scenario.
- Descriptor conversion: translate the command tree into the descriptor shape used by the unified retrieval index (shared with proto tools and widgets — coordinate with `agent-inbox-unified-retrieval`).
- Invocation: synchronous-by-default shell-exec with structured argument binding, sandbox-aware paths per research, captured stdout/stderr stream back into chat.
- Conflict resolution: when a proto tool and a CLI command cover the same thing, proto wins per research.

## Acceptance

- Every cli-core-based scenario shows up with its CLI commands available as conversational surfaces.
- Invocation works end-to-end from a chat turn.
- Proto-vs-CLI conflict resolution matches research spec.

## Coordination

Descriptor shape is shared with `agent-inbox-unified-retrieval`. Workshop should reconcile if both items are shaping the descriptor simultaneously.
name: cli-conversational-agent-inbox-client
title: Build agent-inbox client that discovers, indexes, and invokes CLI commands
